We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is the "compound at hand". We need to get carbon NMR? But aromatic carbons can be identified from carbon NMR? However we could just retrieve carbon shifts ranges? Not enough.

Maybe the system expects we call carbon_nmr_spectra to get spectrum, then infer number of aromatic carbons from number of peaks in aromatic region (~110-160 ppm). But we don't have the spectrum.

We could also call retrieve_carbon_shifts to get typical ranges, but not count.

We need the molecule. Perhaps the environment has a default sample? The tools operate on "sample at hand". So there is a specific compound loaded. We need to get its carbon NMR to count aromatic carbons.

Thus call carbon_nmr_spectra.
